paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: Token Ratio (TR).

annotations.annotation: The bar chart compares the performance of three models across various datasets and their average. The horizontal axis contains categories labeled, in order, as PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis represents the value with a label of "0.0" to "1.0" in linear scale, with tick label intervals of 0.1. Each category consists of three grouped bars, colored dark blue, light blue, and gray, representing RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), respectively. In PT-EVAL, the bars measure approximately 0.42, 0.46, and 1.00; in KoBEST-BQ, they measure 0.52, 0.56, and 1.00; in KoBEST-CP, they measure 0.71, 0.74, and 1.00; in KoBEST-HS, they measure 0.50, 0.54, and 1.00; in KoBEST-SN, they measure 0.69, 0.73, and 1.00; and in AVG, they measure 0.57, 0.61, and 1.00. The bars appear unsorted and are not visually emphasized. All the grey bars are 1.00. A legend is given at the bottom.
